name: Mountaineer Thalos
summary: At Coldridge Pass, Mountaineer Thalos guards the road toward Kharanos, where couriers bring urgent reports. Troggs have overrun the tunnel, and he decides who may cross safely.

sections.title: Guardian of Coldridge Pass
sections.body: Troggs have burrowed up from below and made Coldridge Pass dangerous. At its snowy mouth, where Coldridge Valley gives way to Dun Morogh’s deeper crags, Thalos turns back travelers who are not ready. He tests whether couriers have the grit to face the infested tunnel. If they cannot get through, their reports may never reach the wider kingdom.

sections.title: A Courier's Checkpoint
sections.body: Grelin Whitebeard reports Frostmane troll movements in the secluded valley. A courier carries his account to Grelin’s brother Senir in Kharanos, but first must speak with Mountaineer Thalos. Thalos sends capable travelers through the pass toward Kharanos, where regional commanders coordinate Dun Morogh’s defense. Vital intelligence must reach Ironforge’s military leaders, not vanish in the snow.

faq.answer: Mountaineer Thalos guards the southern opening of Coldridge Pass for Ironforge. He watches the boundary between Coldridge Valley and the rest of Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why is Mountaineer Thalos warning travelers away?
faq.answer: Rockjaw troggs have overrun Coldridge Pass. Thalos warns civilians and novice fighters away, while capable couriers and hardened fighters may enter.

faq.q: Where does Mountaineer Thalos send adventurers?
aliases: where do i go after thalos
faq.answer: Thalos sends travelers through Coldridge Pass toward Kharanos, the nearest settlement on the road to Ironforge.

faq.q: What report does Thalos receive from Senir Whitebeard?
faq.answer: Thalos receives no report from Senir himself. A courier carries Grelin Whitebeard’s account of the Frostmane troll threat in Coldridge Valley to Grelin’s brother Senir in Kharanos. Thalos warns the messenger about the troggs and sends them through the tunnel.

faq.q: What faction does Mountaineer Thalos belong to?
faq.answer: Thalos belongs to the Ironforge Mountaineers, frontier rangers who patrol Dun Morogh’s borders, tunnels, and mountain trails for the Alliance.

faq.q: Is Coldridge Pass impassable without speaking to Thalos?
aliases: do i need to talk to thalos
faq.answer: Anyone can enter Coldridge Pass, but speaking with Thalos lets a traveler carry vital reconnaissance to Kharanos and learn the dangers ahead.

angles.text: As a young dwarf leaving your homeland’s nursery, you meet Thalos, a reminder that the trogg threat presses against Ironforge’s thresholds.
As a gnome traveling from Gnomeregan’s refugee shelters, you find Thalos guarding the main overland route toward Kharanos and Ironforge.
As an Alliance member, you rely on Thalos to keep communication open between the valley’s defensive forces and central Ironforge command.
